method: Complete Japanese prose drafted directly against all Chinese blocks; all five essays reread during composition and checked for scene, argument and qualifications. Old English summary not used. No independent/native-speaker review claimed.
corrections_and_limits: Food nicknames explicitly refer to white wheat, maize and sorghum steamed bread. Grade A ingredients kept as potatoes, vermicelli and cabbage with meat, not potato-starch noodles.
Xiulian workload narrowed to years, not decade-plus at kilns; illness juxtaposition is not certified medical causation. 万元户 is annual-income household status, not a persons rank.
Xu Guoqiang is Xu Aiyuns father; political marriage pressure not attributed to Tian Fujun knowingly. Divorce is described as costly, not legally impossible.
Amputation does not imply inability to give/request/love. Interruption of a repayment logic is a reading of these characters. Alcohol-related accident not declared nonaccidental or monocausal.
Xiaoxia actually facilitated recruitment using fathers name without his knowledge, and proposed a later transfer. Difference from Shaoans decision is not never-helping or never-arranging.
No proof of authorial necessity or historical impossibility for all cross-status couples; three counterfactual routes are not exhaustive.
Jin Xiu wants to work in the mine hospital; provincial-city transfer proposed by Lanxiang and Wu Zhongping, distinct from her affection.
Wang Shicai redirects a steel beam toward himself to save An Suozi; Shaoping witnesses, not rescue beneficiary. Later references consistent.
Final greeting contains Huiying, Mingming and dog, no invented dialogue or definite remarriage.
1988 completion and 1992 death separated by four years; writing not certified cause of death; usefulness not literally denied.
Fidelity is not claimed to erase constraints or to prohibit all help. Refusal of Jin Xiu is not rendered automatic evidence her choice is invalid.
Final ep05 block22 correction: return toward mine, no unsupported departure from railway station.
